gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that decoding a RunCodec from encoding byte 128 (offset 11 within the run-codec range 117-140) produces the correct specifier array {123, 63, 13, 13}.
ADDED i2: Canonical codec at index 13 is BHSDCodec(4, 256); used as the default codec
ADDED i3: The stream provides the extra byte needed to decode the bCodec in the RunCodec. Value 0 in the stream means getCodec(0, ...) returns the defaultCodec.
ADDED i5: Encoding byte 128 signals a RunCodec; the stream byte is consumed to determine bCodec.
ADDED i6: Confirm the stream byte was fully consumed during codec construction
ADDED i7: Retrieve the specifier using UNSIGNED5 as the band's default codec reference
ADDED i8: Expected: {123, 63, 13, 13} encodes RunCodec(16384, canonicalCodec[13], canonicalCodec[13])
